mapper.sql: p.vehicle_penalty_id AS vehiclepenaltyid, p.vehicle_id AS vehicleid, p.violation_type_code AS violationtypecode, p.penalty_amount AS penaltyamount, p.reason AS reason, p.imposed_by_admin_id AS imposedbyadminid, p.imposed_at AS imposedat, p.status_code AS statuscode, v.vehicle_id AS v_vehicleid, v.office_id AS v_officeid, o.office_number AS v_officenumber, v.vehicle_number AS v_vehiclenumber, v.vehicle_model AS v_vehiclemodel, v.owner_name AS v_ownername, v.vehicle_type_code AS v_vehicletypecode, v.registration_type_code AS v_registrationtypecode, v.registration_status_code AS v_registrationstatuscode, v.registered_at AS v_registeredat, v.rejected_reason AS v_rejectedreason, v.created_at AS v_createdat, v.updated_at AS v_updatedat, v.deleted_at AS v_deletedat, a.admin_id AS a_admin_id, a.admin_name AS a_admin_name, a.email AS a_email, a.status_code AS a_status_code, a.created_at AS a_created_at, a.updated_at AS a_updated_at, a.login_id AS a_username
FROM vehicle_penalty p LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN office o ON o.office_id = v.office_id LEFT JOIN admin a ON a.admin_id = p.imposed_by_admin_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_penalty ( vehicle_penalty_id, vehicle_id, violation_type_code, penalty_amount, reason, imposed_by_admin_id, imposed_at, status_code ) VALUES ( SEQ_VEHICLE_PENALTY.NEXTVAL, #{vehicleid}, #{violationtypecode}, #{penaltyamount}, #{reason}, #{imposedbyadminid}, COALESCE(#{imposedat}, SYSDATE), COALESCE(#{statuscode}, 'ACTIVE') )
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY p.imposed_at DESC, p.vehicle_penalty_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle_penalty SET vehicle_id = #{vehicleid}, violation_type_code = #{violationtypecode}, penalty_amount = #{penaltyamount}, reason = #{reason}, imposed_at = COALESCE(#{imposedat}, imposed_at), status_code = #{statuscode} WHERE vehicle_penalty_id = #{vehiclepenaltyid}
